**Daily Devotional**

**March 30**

*9 Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began, (2 Timothy 1:9 KJV)*

This verse tells us that we have a holy calling from the Lord. God has a plan for each one of us, and all we need to do is find out what that plan is, and follow it (Romans 12:1-2). First of all you must be born again (John 3:3). Then you must follow the leading of the Holy Spirit in your life, as God gave man a free will (Deuteronomy 30:19), and God’s desire for our life does not automatically come to pass, as we have to give our will over to the Lord. Notice that His plan for our life is not about our works, but according to His purpose and grace, and His desire for us is always in our best interest also.

The least we can do is to give ourselves to the Lord for His purposes, as He gave His all to save us, so He owns us as He paid the price (1 Corinthians 19:20). It is my testimony that when you give yourselves to the Lord 100 percent, that you are not just saved, but He gives you joy, peace and patience, and He puts His desires in your heart, and gives you a blessed life here and now, not just when we all get to heaven. Serving God’s call on your life is heaven on earth. You should try it, and you will find joy and peace like you have never known. Thank you Lord.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
